explore.subtitle: Nature & Passion
explore.title: Explore with Heidi
explore.description: Discover the authenticity of the Valaisian mountains. Enjoy the gentle altitude and the scent of pine trees to experience a rich and enriching experience in a preserved environment. Here, no artifice, we let you taste the traditions of the fabulous Alpine park. Get to know passionate people who have preserved the art of simplicity and authenticity. Activities, gourmet walks, discovery of the mountain, fauna, flora and nature activities to draw together your most beautiful memories of the Valais.

aboutHeidi.description: Founder & "Happiness Dealer" of Beeheidi, Sandra, it's the little girl of an alpinist who blew the taste of the mountains into her.

ourTeam.title: Our team
ourTeam.description: Authentic lovers of nature and terroir, discover the members of our team, always ready to make you live beautiful emotions!

services.subtitle: Our services adapted to your needs
services.title: Live a unique experience in the heart of the Alps with us!
services.description: From a simple day to a complete stay with overnight stays, we compose for you! Team Building, Valais discovery, sports activities or gourmet, everything is possible!
services.youAre: Discover the services we can offer you, whether you are :
whyUsList: We are local actors at human scale and put forward our terroir.
Authenticity, Quality & Safety are part of our key values!
We work with professionalism while prioritizing the client's safety and we are insured for the activities we offer.
But above all, our team is made up of passionate people who perfectly know the Valais and its wonders and have a heart to share them, in all simplicity.
services.experience: Live a unique experience in the heart of the Alps with us!
services.experienceDescription: Whether you want a simple afternoon discovery or stay in Valais, we will organize the activities you desire! Share your wishes with us by contacting us immediately.
